description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated enums and notification mechanisms.
external_methods: implied by usage of QueryInterface and Release

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing access to system metadata such as build hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for managing and querying various system subsystems and their statuses, including notifications and version info.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for subsystem status changes.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem information, including callsign.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet connectivity information, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface for location data such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details, including architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the system.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for subsystem events.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets subsystem information for a specific subsystem type.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves subsystem information for a specific subsystem type.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific subsystem is active.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the system.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts network type enum to string representation.

methods.name: TimeSync
methods.description: Returns the current time synchronization status.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next provisioning or decryption info.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous provisioning or decryption info.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of provisioning or decryption entries.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current provisioning or decryption info.
